name: GPS operational satellite navigation
description: A satellite constellation and receiver system provided position and timing information, with initial U.S. operational capability declared in 1993.

date.basis: The cited source dates this scoped episode.

events.statement: The U.S. Department of Defense declared GPS initial operational capability and made its Standard Positioning Service available to the Department of Transportation.
events.caveats: Initial operational capability is not the first positioning test; civilian service then covered the C/A-code signal, and reception and accuracy varied.

evidence.supports: GPS meeting record notes initial operational capability declared on 8 December 1993.

evidence.locator: Appendix C, IOC and FOC definitions
evidence.supports: The standard dates IOC and identifies the government handover and signal scope.

contributions.resource: Managed and operated GPS for the U.S. government

evidence.locator: Section 1, The GPS Standard Positioning Service
evidence.supports: November 1993 specification identifies the U.S. Air Force as system operator.

date.basis: 2020 standard distinguishes the date full operational capability was achieved from its 17 July 1995 public announcement.

events.statement: The GPS satellite constellation reached full operational capability on 27 April 1995; the Department of Defense announced it publicly on 17 July.
events.caveats: The civilian standard service scope was limited to the C/A-code signal.

evidence.supports: Government statement identifies 1995 full operational capability.

evidence.locator: Appendix C, IOC and FOC definitions
evidence.supports: The standard distinguishes achievement and announcement dates, and the civilian signal scope.

earliest_record.rationale: Earliest dated episode established in the cited passages for this scoped referent; no global priority beyond the event is assumed.

caveats: The first GPS satellite launched in 1978; a launch alone is not the same as an operational positioning constellation.

research.note: Independent reader checked the named reviewed facets against the cited documents; no global priority or unreported funding inferred.
